scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:design-tools && npm run build --workspace @aesir/docs
scripts.build:web: npm run tokens:web && npm run build --workspace @aesir/svelte && npm run build --workspace @aesir/html && node tools/distribution/check-html-bundle.mjs
scripts.docs:build: npm run tokens && npm run build --workspace @aesir/docs
scripts.check:build: npm run build && npm run check:types && npm run check:svelte-source && npm run check:package-install && npm run lint
scripts.check:types: npm run build --workspace @aesir/svelte && npm run check:types --workspace @aesir/svelte && npm run check:types --workspace @aesir/docs
scripts.check:packages: npm run build:web && npm run check:package-install
scripts.distribution:flutter: npm run tokens:design-tools && node tools/distribution/flutter-package.mjs branch
scripts.distribution:svelte: npm run tokens:web && node tools/distribution/svelte-package.mjs branch
scripts.tokens: npm run tokens:web && npm run tokens:design-tools
scripts.tokens:design-tools: npm run build --workspace @aesir/penpot && npm run build --workspace @aesir/figma && npm run build --workspace @aesir/flutter
scripts.test: node --test tools/distribution/*.test.mjs tools/docs/*.test.mjs && npm test --workspace @aesir/svelte && npm test --workspace @aesir/html && npm test --workspace @aesir/docs && npm test --workspace @aesir/penpot && npm test --workspace @aesir/figma && npm test --workspace @aesir/flutter
